messages:
Alex: Heads-up — PR #18944 is green on unit/integration but the cross-region e2e matrix is flaky for ap-southeast. job ci-e2e-cross-region/ap-southeast shows timeouts ~50%. Not comfortable merging before canary. cc @Nora @Jen
Nora: Can you paste the failing snippet and the job link?
Alex: Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/ci-e2e-cross-region/237 — failing step: checkout+bootstrap -> timeout. Log: ```
--- FAIL: TestUserReplication (0.00s)
    replication_test.go:72: expected replica count 3, got 1
    timeout: context deadline exceeded
```
Alex: Also seeing increased latency traces around 2026-03-17T22:10:00Z across AZ failover.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by @Alex — queued as job #238 (target: ap-southeast).
Jen: Thanks. I agree we should not auto-merge into main if cross-region is unstable. Proposed plan: hold this PR, run targeted reruns x3; if all pass, canary at 10% for 1h. If flakiness persists, defer to post-maintenance. :thinking_face:
Sam: We have the maintenance blackout starting 02:00 UTC tonight. If we can't get stability before then, I suggest delaying until after maintenance where we can increase canary to 20% safely.
Alex: OK. Actionable: 1) remove auto-merge, 2) run 3 targeted reruns for ap-southeast, 3) if 3/3 pass -> merge and immediate 10% canary; Jen to approve after 1h monitoring. If any fail -> hold for post-maintenance. Asking for one approval now to lock the plan.
Jen: :thumbsup: will monitor first hour after canary and give manual approval if stable.
ci-bot: Job #238 completed — failed (timeout). Logs: ```
ERROR: Step "bootstrap" exceeded 15m timeout
context deadline exceeded
Exit code: 124
```
Alex: Re-ran a targeted diagnostic: `./test/e2e --region=ap-southeast --filter=replication` — on dev infra it reproduced once, then passed. I'm leaning to postpone until after maintenance given infra noise. Removing auto-merge now and updating PR description with the plan + @release-team FYI.
Nora: Sounds good. Please add the roll-forward/rollback checklist in the PR too so release ops can act quickly if needed.
Alex: Done — PR comment added and auto-merge off. Thanks everyone.
